evidenceBasis.sourceValidity: Source fidelity only; no certification of current legal validity or historical source bytes.
evidenceBasis.scopeMeaning: 40 old-owned candidates for complete new-ID supersession, not already-obsolete or approved deletions. Preserve all 33 shared document/chunk objects. No global graph census claimed.
evidenceBasis.scopeOutsideInventory: All other nodes, SourceTopic/aggregate objects, source registries and other drafts are outside deletion scope. No prefix, URL-wide, namespace-wide, content-duplicate or internal-ID-only deletion.
evidenceBasis.labels: Expected Entity plus namespace-qualified type label, inherited from exact membership checks; full actual label sets and properties must be captured again before deletion.
evidenceBasis.internalIds: Expected historical database-local IDs, not stable mutation identifiers; renewed identity/provenance verification required, abort on mismatch or reuse.

rowContract.databaseQualification: Every row is qualified by its enclosing partition.database; identity is the exact tuple (database, exactSemanticId), never the unqualified ID or short recordKey.
rowContract.lengthSemantics: For nodes: decoded UTF-8 content/summary character length from boundary.nodes. For historical ownership or shared_external_historical_chunk: stored property length from boundary.additionalObjects, which may include JSON encoding; do not treat as decoded length.
rowContract.hashSemantics: SHA256 of staged UTF-8 content (Chunk) or summary (ReferenceDocument), attributable to decoded live value only through boundary exact equality. Not a graph-native bodyHash and not a full-node/vector hash.
rowContract.nullHash: Historical body unequal to staged body or not hashed. No fingerprint invented. Capture renewed raw/decoded hashes and full properties in protected rollback snapshot before deletion; capture full-properties baselines for ALL 33 preserve rows before import.
rowContract.historicalOwnershipEvidence: boundary.additionalEvidenceContract: exact promoted sourcePath/localSnapshotPath identifies ownership; sourceDocumentRefId identifies shared external dependency. Preserve original contract and additionalObjects row in protected execution evidence.
rowContract.canonicalStoredContentHashes: Additionally retain and read back all three boundary.storedCanonicalContentHashes; these differ from the decoded summary hashes in rows.

automationOverrideAssessment.requiredResolution: Before any submit, separately approve and verify an effective process-local no-spawn hold, or a supported operational pause with proof that existing jobs/schedulers cannot race. Setting ENABLED=0 alone is not sufficient; no service config changes are proposed or performed by this manifest.
automationOverrideAssessment.existingProcessLocalNamespaceGuard: ERP_KB_AUTOMATION_ALLOWED_NAMESPACES overrides stored namespaces. A nonempty list excluding all four target namespaces makes trigger return namespace_not_allowed without options.force. Empty list allows all, not none. This is static code evidence, not an established hold: separately approve/verify exclusion, child/process inheritance and protection against independent schedulers before use.

supportedSupersession.condition: Supported composable new-ID supersession is sufficient only after effective hold, version ledger, backup, compensation and separate execution signoff are established.
supportedSupersession.submit: scripts/lib/knowledge_inbox.mjs:200-247 submitKnowledgeDraft(input, {silent:true}); translate pack payload.namespace to kbNamespace and supply kbName from TARGET_KBS; retain title/content/sourceUrl/tags/metadata, including supersedesDraftId. Never pass payload.namespace alone.
supportedSupersession.promote: scripts/lib/promoted_knowledge.mjs:296-375 promoteDraft(newFullId, {promotedBy,reviewNote}); local only; no force needed for new IDs.
supportedSupersession.withdraw: scripts/lib/promoted_knowledge.mjs:412-473 withdrawPromotedDraft(oldFullId, {withdrawnBy,reviewNote}); archive by supported move, after independent immutable backup of both raw/promoted JSON/MD and prior registry entry.
supportedSupersession.withdrawArchiveCaveat: Flat withdrawn destination can overwrite an earlier same-basename archive; snapshot destination and original versions before withdrawal. No batch transaction or enforced supersedes relation.
supportedSupersession.ledger: Durable full old-to-new draft-ID ledger with namespace, payload/content hashes, source evidence fingerprints from correction pack, operator, timestamps, stage status, archive paths and compensation progress. Metadata/review notes alone do not enforce supersession.
supportedSupersession.avoid: No direct raw/promoted edits, reopen-and-force republish, dashboard promote-export or withdraw-build shortcuts during separated local preparation.

executionOrderingProposal.required: Obtain separate execution signoff for local supersession/publication; bind both input hashes and this manifest hash. Resolve automation hold despite ENABLED=0 semantics. Check effective code, quotas, permissions, no in-flight jobs/independent schedulers and exclusive correction window. Do not submit if hold is unproved.

Before any lifecycle/import change, capture full rollback snapshot of old raw/promoted JSON/MD, original registry entries and version/archive destinations, audit/automation provenance, staged files/manifests and all relevant graph/index state. Internally protected full-properties backup for all 40 old nodes INCLUDING vectors, every actual label, database/semantic identity and relationship/referrer inventory; no projection-only backup. Record checksums, access restrictions, restore procedure and independently verify restore completeness. Capture all 33 preserve objects, body/full-properties/vector hashes and canonical contentHash baselines. Renew before deletion if anything changed.

With requested per-process ERP_KB_AUTOMATION_ENABLED=0 PLUS separately verified effective hold, submit exactly 14 corrected payloads through submitKnowledgeDraft with correct kbName/kbNamespace. Record returned full IDs and paths, verify automation.started=false. Stop and compensate partial JSON/MD writes or any unexpected automation activity; no blind retry producing extra successors.

Verify 14 distinct new IDs unequal to old IDs; exact namespace/source URL, complete trimmed UTF-8 content hash, raw JSON/MD body equality and no truncation, correction metadata/evidence and full predecessor ledger. Pack is reviewed summaries, not preservation of the entire PDF. Verify old originals remain untouched and active until this gate passes.

Promote verified successors through promoteDraft; verify 14 promoted contents via supported loader. Only then withdraw all 14 exact originals through withdrawPromotedDraft, recording both full IDs in notes/ledger. Verify archives and withdrawn registry states, old snapshots absent from promoted loader, exactly 14 successors present. Checkpoint each operation; partial success requires compensation. Not atomic across files/registry/drafts.

After publication signoff, export only four affected namespaces via their supported exporters. Namespace export rewrites whole configured staged files, not a 14-row-only exporter. Derive successor document/chunk IDs from actual CSV rows/provenance, record complete new inventory and fingerprints, assert all 40 old-owned IDs absent and all 33 preserve projections unchanged. Validate duplicate IDs, token/content limits and full staged diff; stop on unrelated drift. Do not infer new IDs from titles or assume one chunk per draft.

Force reference_document.csv,chunk.csv only for these four KBs with OPENSPG_FORCE_FILES=reference_document.csv,chunk.csv using supported build runners. Inspect refreshed upload/build manifests, successful completion and exact live successor label/ID/content/provenance readback for all 14 drafts and every new descendant. Force is UPSERT, not pruning. Verify all 33 preserve hashes including full protected baselines, and any aggregate/reference impact before cleanup.

Renew database-qualified counts=1, expected internal IDs/labels, full old properties/content/evidence fingerprints, sourcePath/localSnapshotPath/sourceDocumentRefId ownership, incoming/outgoing relationships and property-based referrers for all 40 candidates. Reconcile against current new/preserve inventories: removal intersection with either must be empty. Confirm preserved33 membership/hash baselines. Abort on unexpected relationship, count, provenance, ID collision/reuse, shared dependency or drift; do not detach or broaden. Refresh protected complete vectors-inclusive rollback backup and verify restore readiness. Obtain separate explicit operator signoff naming exact (database,id) 40-object allowlist, refreshed fingerprints, successor build/readback evidence, rollback snapshot checksum and manifest hash.

Only after order8 separate signoff and successful successor builds/readback, apply exact old-only cleanup with semantic ID equality and checked identity/provenance in each database; no prefix/URL/content duplicate sweep and no deletion of shared33 or new descendants. Recheck preconditions in the write transaction. No cross-database atomicity claimed; journal exact committed objects and halt on partial failure for separately approved compensation.

Prove all 40 old IDs absent, all successor descendants present with expected hashes/provenance, all 33 preserve IDs/hashes unchanged, and unrelated/shared metadata not removed. Reconcile topic/aggregate effects separately without widening deletion scope. Retain protected backups and evidence ledger; release hold only under operator control after verification.

successorInventory.knownAfter: submission then actual export; exact full graph membership established only after build/readback

compensationRollback.beforeCleanup: On partial submit/promote/withdraw/import, stop further changes, keep hold, checkpoint effects. Restore original promoted visibility through supported lifecycle operations where applicable, preserving new versions and archives; restoring exact registry metadata/files/index state requires the separately approved protected snapshot restore procedure. Re-promoting raw alone is not exact version restoration. Do not blindly overwrite a concurrently changed registry or force-repromote without backup.
compensationRollback.afterCleanup: Restore committed old-object subset from protected full-properties/vector snapshot with exact semantic IDs, labels, property types and relationships/referrers; restore affected graph/index and local/staged state as approved. Internal IDs may change on restore: regenerate mapping and verify semantic/provenance equality. Remove/withdraw successor exposure only with separate rollback signoff and exact verified successor inventory, never guessed IDs.
compensationRollback.signoffRequired: Execution and deletion signoffs must separately accept non-atomic operation and tested compensation; this manifest grants neither.

operatorSignoff.instruction: Preparation approval is not execution/delete consent. Supply a separate signed approval record binding the explicit database-qualified allowlist and refreshed evidence; do not interpret this unsigned manifest or previous broad replacement approval as authorization.

remainingBlockers.detail: ENABLED=0 does not override stored enabled=true; effective no-spawn hold and exclusion of independent/in-flight jobs remain unverified.
User approved preparation only. Neither local/publication execution nor exact graph deletes authorized.
14 new draft IDs and all new descendant IDs unknown. No deletion before successful full successor build/readback and disjointness check.

Supported primitives lack batch transaction/CAS/enforced supersession; flat archives may overwrite. Quotas, permissions, exclusive window, job state, full staged diff, aggregate effects and restore readiness not checked at runtime.
